name: Luzerne County Salt Shed
hero_alt: Completed Luzerne County Salt Shed building
paragraphs: This ground-up storage building gives Luzerne County a dedicated facility for road salt and winter maintenance materials, protecting supplies from the weather and keeping them ready for deployment when storms hit.
Kobalt Construction handled the building's construction from the ground up, delivering a durable, functional storage facility built to hold up to the demands of municipal use.
